essence: Bow to the freedom-giver: Śiva, sun against becoming-darkness.
Bow to Śambhu: fancy-net smasher, past supreme-bliss stage.
Feet triumph: essence divided from nonessence, awakening caused.
All faculties turn back before the worship-worthy we worship.
I bow to pure awareness: sole knife for the mine-I knot.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder settling into quiescence)
rasa.justification: Wonder at the praised Lord — sun, smasher, triumphant feet, retreating faculties — settles by v6 into pure awareness, knife-still; praise becomes quiescence before method begins.

sections.BOUNDARY: No method is taught; the question of speaking the undescribed belongs to the teaching that follows.
sections.EXPLANATION: Six bows, four verbs of bowing (namaḥ, vande, namo 'stu, naumi, upāsmahe): freedom given whole-blessinged; theology-possession refused; fancy-nets smashed past bliss; feet dividing real from sham; all faculties retreating before the worship-worthy; pure awareness knifing the mine-I knot and devouring throb and throbless.
sections.FUNCTION: Establishes whom the teaching comes from and what it cuts, before any method is taught.
sections.KEY TERMS: namaḥ/vande/namo 'stu/naumi (bowing verbs) — fourfold praise; kaivalya (freedom) — the gift; svasaṃvedana (self-feeling) — known only thus; svastha (self-abiding) — the praised state; āveśa (possession-sickness) — refused; spanda-aspanda (throb and throbless) — devoured; hṛdgranthi (heart-knot) — mine-and-I, knifed.
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The six praises pledge the doctrine's source and temper; method and fruit taught beyond answer to this Lord.
sections.RELATED: Hanneder codex unicus (ZDMG 2017); Bhūti(rāja) ascription cautious, identity unasserted; self-feeling axis planted here, guarded throughout.
sections.SUMMARY: Freedom given, views refused, fancies smashed, feet triumphant, faculties retreating, awareness knifed clean — six bows name their Lord whole-blessing, past-bliss, theology-free, worship-worthy, mine-I-cutting.
